data.one_liner: A swipeable button widget with ripple animated pages.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable swipe-to-action button that triggers a ripple animation and handles completion states. It supports configurable colors, text styles, and icons for building interactive sliders like payment confirmations.
use_when: You need a slide-to-confirm or swipe-to-payment UI interaction
You want a button that triggers a ripple animation upon sliding
avoid_when: You require complex gesture physics beyond a simple horizontal slider
You are building a standard tap-based button
strengths: Easy to integrate and configure with well-documented properties
Includes customizable colors, text, and active states
weaknesses: Minimal maintenance history with only two early versions
